item.title: vx32: Lightweight User-level Sandboxing on the x86 ↗
item.content:encoded:
vx32: Lightweight User-level Sandboxing on the x86

A sample share, also a draft. A log with a link becomes a share: its title is the link text, the body is your comment. YouTube links get an inline player.

item.title: webframe v0.2 ↗
item.content:encoded:
webframe v0.2

webframe is now a tool for scripting and testing pages, not just watching them. You can inject stubs, run test files after load, pass in secrets, set timeouts, and let the page set the exit status, and hidden pages run unthrottled on every platform.

item.title: webframe v0.1 ↗
item.content:encoded:
webframe v0.1

The first release of webframe, which runs a web page like a program: it loads a URL in a hidden web view and wires its console to stdout, its exceptions to stderr, and stdin to a JavaScript REPL. It's a single ~5 MB binary that uses the webview your OS already has.

item.title: Wanix v0.4 Preview: Composable compute in HTML ↗
item.content:encoded:
Wanix v0.4 Preview: Composable compute in HTML

Wanix Elements are web components for declaring filesystems, tasks, VMs, terminals, and even VS Code in plain HTML, so you can build a sandboxed Unix-style environment in the browser with a few tags. This preview also adds the rc shell and a Wanix-ready Alpine Linux as CDN extras.

item.title: Apptron v0.7: Offline Sites, Console Embeds, and Much More ↗
item.content:encoded:
Apptron v0.7: Offline Sites, Console Embeds, and Much More

Our biggest Apptron release yet. Embeds can now be just a terminal in Console Mode, public sites work offline with an automatic service worker, and environments got 4x faster networking and up to 2x faster builds.
